name: mirage
text: Done, live on the engine now: bids may put up to $25 a game (was $10) and the total of resting bids may reach 1200% of the wallet (was 800%). Every bid still needs at least 2% edge from fair odds built on well-known books, 3+ books agreeing, and stays small (1/16 Kelly, $3 max each), so the $25 per game is spread over many different lines (totals, team totals, spreads, halves, props) instead of one big bid. NFL bids have been the best bid type so far (team totals +41%, halves +28% on small samples). I did not lower the 2% floor, since a worse price would give up quality for fills. I'll check next digest how many fills this brings; to undo, tell me and I set $10 and 800% back.
